added.summary: A style pack's theme takes four more scales, filled from the design tokens in the default pack: `duration` (ms: duration-instant, -fast, -base, -slow, -control and the loop names, also for delay-*), `opacity` (opacity-dim, -muted, -soft, -faint, -wash), `stroke` (line widths for border-*, ring-*, inset-ring-* and outline-*: hairline, thin, regular, thick, edge) and `scale` (scale-press, -swell, -pop, -shrink). A theme that sets one restyles every component that names it; a colour of the same name still wins on ring and border.

The built-in components name these tokens instead of fixed numbers (duration-control for a control's own state change, opacity-dim for a disabled or down state, ring-regular and border-thick for their edges), so a theme's motion, dimming and line weight reach them. They look and move as before under the default pack.
